Name: (DGA) Cafe And Bakery Set
Author: EnderTedi
Description:
[center][b][color=#e69138][size=6]﻿Cafe And Bakery Set[/size]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/GMGHSZc.png[/img]﻿[/color][/b][/center][size=3]A mod adding in furniture and other miscellaneous items for decorating and filling up your own Cafe and Bakery builds! Perfect for a comfy feel! This mod was originally inspired by the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10274]Cafe Valley[/url] and was designed to be a port of it from Custom Furniture into Dynamic Game Assets without being a one-to-one conversion of it, and has since been expanded and updated to create it's own identity outside of it.

All items are found either at Robin's (Furniture Items) or Gus's (Food & Non-Furniture Items)
[i]
Note: [/i]Large counters and cabinets have 2 different vertical versions, a normal one and one thats a bit longer in order to connect countertops correctly

[/size][b][size=4]Requirements:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿[/size][/b]
[*][b][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿[/size][/b]
[*][url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9365][size=3]Dynamic Game Assets[/size][/url]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=3]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]﻿﻿[/size]
[/list]

[/list][/b]
